# ChatMessage

> Composable chat message with stable inline editing, bubble or flat layout, grouped bursts, reactions, and replies.

This file matches the installed `chat-message` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/chat-message.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/chat-message.md`.

## Composition

### Editable message

ChatMessageEditable owns the plain-text draft and defaults to Copy/Edit actions. Edit toggles the message into edit mode in place: the bubble keeps its size and the read-mode actions give their row to Cancel and Save. The host persists onSave; rejection keeps the draft for retry. Escape cancels, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter saves, and Enter inserts a newline. Optional children customize the read-mode ActionBar, for example a ChatMessageTime beside the actions.

```tsx
<ChatMessage>
  <ChatMessageRow>
    <ChatMessageBody>
      <ChatMessageEditable>
        value={text} onSave={saveMessage}
      </ChatMessageEditable>
    </ChatMessageBody>
  </ChatMessageRow>
</ChatMessage>
```

### Message with actions

```tsx
<ChatMessage>
  <ChatMessageRow>
    <ChatMessageAvatar />
    <ChatMessageBody>
      <ChatMessageHeader />
      <ChatMessageContent>
        message content
      </ChatMessageContent>
      <ChatMessagePending />
      <ChatMessageActions>
        <ActionBar />
      </ChatMessageActions>
    </ChatMessageBody>
  </ChatMessageRow>
</ChatMessage>
```

### Team message

```tsx
<ChatMessage>
  from="participant" layout="flat"
  <ChatMessageRow>
    <ChatMessageAvatar>
      Avatar, or ChatMessageTime on a continuation
    </ChatMessageAvatar>
    <ChatMessageBody>
      <ChatMessageHeader>
        <ChatMessageAuthor />
        <ChatMessageTime />
      </ChatMessageHeader>
      <ChatMessageContent>
        message content
      </ChatMessageContent>
      <ChatMessageFooter />
      <ChatMessageReactions>
        <ChatMessageReaction />
      </ChatMessageReactions>
      <ChatMessageReplySummary />
      <ChatMessageReplies />
    </ChatMessageBody>
    <ChatMessageActions>
      <ActionBar />
    </ChatMessageActions>
  </ChatMessageRow>
</ChatMessage>
```

### Typing indicator

```tsx
<ChatTypingIndicator>
  who is typing
</ChatTypingIndicator>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import {
  Activity,
  ActivityContent,
  ActivityDetail,
  ActivityDetailContent,
  ActivityDetailLabel,
  ActivityIcon,
  ActivityTitle,
  ActivityTrigger,
} from "@/components/control-ui/activity";
import {
  ChatMessage,
  ChatMessageBody,
  ChatMessageContent,
  ChatMessageEditable,
  ChatMessageHeader,
  ChatMessageRow,
} from "@/components/control-ui/chat-message";

export function ChatMessageExample() {
  const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState("Does this render the active setup?");
  return (
    <div>
      <ChatMessage from="user">
        <ChatMessageRow>
          <ChatMessageBody>
            <ChatMessageEditable value={prompt} onSave={setPrompt} />
          </ChatMessageBody>
        </ChatMessageRow>
      </ChatMessage>
      <ChatMessage from="assistant" state="streaming">
        <ChatMessageRow>
          <ChatMessageBody>
            <ChatMessageHeader>Assistant</ChatMessageHeader>
            <ChatMessageContent>
              <span>Provider-owned parts compose directly into the installed message anatomy.</span>
            </ChatMessageContent>
            <Activity kind="tool" name="active_setup" state="success">
              <ActivityTrigger>
                <ActivityIcon />
                <ActivityTitle>Active setup</ActivityTitle>
              </ActivityTrigger>
              <ActivityContent>
                <ActivityDetail>
                  <ActivityDetailLabel>Input</ActivityDetailLabel>
                  <ActivityDetailContent format="code">{`{ "surface": "control-ui" }`}</ActivityDetailContent>
                </ActivityDetail>
                <ActivityDetail>
                  <ActivityDetailLabel>Output</ActivityDetailLabel>
                  <ActivityDetailContent>adaptive source</ActivityDetailContent>
                </ActivityDetail>
              </ActivityContent>
            </Activity>
          </ChatMessageBody>
        </ChatMessageRow>
      </ChatMessage>
    </div>
  );
}
```
